static_traits.name: 韩莉
static_traits.social_status: 有几位关系Good的朋友，但在感觉自己是失败者时倾向自我隔离；对与朋友谈论失败与not足感感到not适
static_traits.medical_history: not yet经历类似问题；not yet接受过心理问题的治疗或咨询；No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，能具体描述情绪与想法；合作度Good；思维易陷入负性自动化（如“I am a failure”）；use“应该”句式（如“我应该自己能处理”）；语气中性

basic_info.main_problem: 我在最近输掉一场象棋比赛后，陷入失败感和自我not足的困扰。
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings of failure have significantly affected my overall mood and daily activities.

special_situations.event: 在最近的象棋比赛中失利
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not赢，就说明I am not good enough / I am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly comforts oneself 'this is just one setback', and avoids talking about this matter with friends

special_situations.event: 当想到再次下象棋或做自己通常擅长的事情
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果这次not能表现完美，就证明我not行
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避参与或降低投入，减少面对可能的失败
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我可能会再次失败，这会证明I am not good enough

special_situations.event: 在求职或想到找工作时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一次比赛的失利意味着我在其他领域也not会做好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 推迟求职、避免挑战以减少失败的风险
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果连一局都赢not了，我在工作上也会失败

special_situations.event: 想到向朋友分享自己的失败与not足感时
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 我应该自己处理，not应该麻烦do not人；表达脆弱会被看低
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 自我隔离，避免谈论相关话题
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not该把这事告诉do not人，我应该自己能撑过去

core_conflict.wish: 渴望通过能力与胜利Gaining recognition，维持稳定的自尊与价值感
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被看作失败、被他人negate；害怕暴露脆弱后被评判
defense_goal: 保持距离以避免羞耻与被评判
Repression脆弱与失败感以维持表面控制

object_relations.object_representation: 他人可能会评判或看not起我

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others invite her to talk about competition losses and feelings of failure, or try to challenge her negative labels
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing that exposing vulnerability will lead to being looked down on, and that one should solve problems alone
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气含蓄保留，减少use情绪词汇；尽量转向事实性描述并强调“我自己会处理”，对细节轻描淡写或回避

manifestations: 在感到失败时倾向自我隔离
not愿与支持性朋友讨论失败与not足感

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: 表达“我应该自己能处理”
以外在规则苛责自己并回避求助

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or things, or gives up seeking others to do something for them, and instead does it to the self, corresponding to 'impulse'.语言表现为：“算了我忍着”，“我not该麻烦do not人”等。
manifestations: 感觉失败时转而自我隔离
减少向朋友或他人寻求支持的行为

positive_force: 有支持性的朋友可提供情感支持
在象棋方面具备稳定skill与以往的成就感（通常表现优秀）
Able to notice and name negative thought patterns, willing to try reframing
主动寻求咨询以改善情绪与日常功能
negative_force: 将自我价值过度绑定于单次表现与胜负
存在过度概括、非黑即白、心理过滤与negate积极的认知偏差
羞耻与自我要求促使回避求助、社会隔离
Disrupted sleep rhythm与Decreased attention，维持负性循环

antecedent: 想到再次下棋或进行擅长活动时
想要向朋友谈论失败感时
target_behavior.core_reason: Fears being judged, strong sense of shame; 'should'-style self-demands push one to solve problems alone
target_behavior.function: 逃避not受欢迎的评价与羞耻情绪，维持表面控制感
target_behavior.consequence: 支持系统利用not足，Loneliness与负面情绪加重，求职与日常功能受损

target_behavior.behavior: 持续的Self-denial自动思维（如“I am a failure”）
antecedent: 面对挑战或尝试擅长任务时
target_behavior.core_reason: 过度概括、非黑即白、心理过滤与negate积极的认知偏差；将自我价值过度依赖于表现
target_behavior.function: 维持认知一致性与自我解释，短期避免面对复杂且not确定的自我评价
target_behavior.consequence: Rising stress、Sleep disturbance、Decreased attention，Self-doubt泛化到其他领域
